articles.title: When Debate Amplifies Risk: Social-Bias Vulnerabilities in Multi-Agent Safety Deliberation
articles.summary: Retrieval-augmented Web applications increasingly employ multi-agent debate (MAD) to aggregate conflicting, noisy, and heterogeneous information, yet deliberation is fundamentally a social process susceptible to interpersonal dynamics. When retrieved Web sources contain latent hazards alongside safe factual content, social biases such as conformity pressure and authority deference can override evidence-grounded safety boundaries. In this work, we investigate whether the social structure of deliberation can paradoxically amplify latent Web safety risks. We introduce SafeConflict-Bias, a controlled counterfactual diagnostic protocol spanning six core Web risk categories, which holds queries and retrieved evidence strictly invariant while isolating conversational majority sway, authority cues, and confidence asymmetry. Empirical evaluation across diverse proprietary and open-source backbones reveals that while isolated models reliably reject unsafe guidance, standard MAD catastrophically capitulates to social pressure---surging unsafe adoption from 0.0\% up to 100.0\% and systematically silencing safe minority evidence. rights.modified: 仅收录标题、时间与原始链接；未收录正文

editorial.lead:
概述：据 IT之家报道，松下电器机电宣布向 AI 相关业务投入 920 亿日元，涉及多层基板材料、电容器产能和下一代半导体封装材料研发。项目包含分期投产安排，尚不能理解为新增产能已经全部释放。

核心要点：
1. 苏州与泰国大城府的新工厂分别计划投入 300 亿、370 亿日元，预计于 2028 年 8 月、2029 年 4 月投运。
2. 日本宇治与印尼峇淡的 SP-Cap 电容器项目计划合计投入约 170 亿日元，面向 GPU 等 AI 服务器元件的中长期需求。
3. 四日市的新研发大楼计划投入约 80 亿日元，重点是下一代半导体封装材料；这些均为公司公布的建设和投资计划。
